feeds.title: Blerdy Otome
feeds.description: Blerdy Otome is an otome games and visual novel review site that runs on Black Girl Magic and Dreams. While I mostly focus on romance-themed games, I've been known to cover a wide range of nerdy and otaku-themed topics.

feeds.title: Breadmasterlee » Otome Games
feeds.description: Welcome to 'Kawaii Janakya Dame nano!' I am your writer Yurika. This originally started out as a Pangya blog which spread out into a general foreign mmo blog, which then had some otome games added on to it, and before I knew I was blogging about every game I was playing. The site's main focus now is whatever game I currently finish. Read otome games posts in my blog.

feeds.title: Otome Adventures
feeds.description: This is supposed to be various thoughts/reviews of otome games I've played or to be played. My name is Theresa. I'm from Canada and I'm striving to become a voice actress. I love playing video games of all sorts and reading different manga.

feeds.title: Zettai Renai
feeds.description: Hello & welcome to Zettai Renai. This blog was started back in 2015 for me to write down my ramblings about otome games and drama CDs, however, I started to expand into other kinds of visual novels. The purpose of this blog is to provide reviews/impressions of both VNs and Drama CDs.

feeds.title: Rurunukiri
feeds.description: Rurunukiri is a Jrpg and Otome game blog. Find articles about gaming.

feeds.title: Xanhvert
feeds.description: I'm Green, a useless donut who owns this site. I am easily influenced. Personality changes depending on the time of the month and what you just read. So writing an introduction is always torture because I change like a pinwheel. My hobby is doing silly things that have no benefit but waste time like playing games, wading through seiyuu news, downloading games, writing crap, imagining all kinds of things in my head, terrorizing people around me by telling the sick details of what you just watched.

feeds.title: Otome Kitten
feeds.description: Kitty Chlo here! I'm a corporate slave by day and a damsel in distress by night. This website was initially started for the sole purpose of posting my own personal reviews regarding the otome games I play. I also cover otome and joseimuke news, as well as provide thorough game walkthroughs.

feeds.title: Chocolatemix
feeds.description: Chocolatemix is maintained by Chromite and Yume, who both decided to randomly create this to post about their various interests. This can range from games, novels, comics, music, or even our own projects. Whatever it is, we hope you enjoy reading! Jellyfish pixels are from Shizoo Design.

feeds.title: Sweet & Spicy
feeds.description: Sweet & Spicy aim to review otome games not to decide what is 'good' or 'bad', but to show each game and character's appeal so you can choose where to spend your time, energy, and money. With countless otome games to choose from - each with multiple characters and endings - it can be overwhelming to decide where to start, and no one wants to waste time playing a game they don't enjoy.

feeds.title: Uguu Cage of Love
feeds.description: Uguu Cage of Love is written by Yukina. She is interested in Otome games, animu, and mango. His favorite Otome games are Black Wolves Saga Bloody Nightmare, Eikoku Tantei Mysteria, Will o Wisp, Noise Voice of Snow, and AMNESIA.

feeds.title: Yankee Banchou
feeds.description: YankeeBanchou is a blog that I occasionally update with stuff I like to talk about. Most of that stuff is my hobby of playing otome games, listening to drama CDs, and reading magazines. This blog is more of a hobby for me to keep me productive and to share my interests.

feeds.title: Otome Land
feeds.description: This blog is basically just me writing my opinions about otome games, sharing my experiences and trying to make some friends through this amazing hobby. My name's Ilaria, I'm Italian and I've been playing otome games since 2013.

feeds.title: The Rambling Game
feeds.description: Hello all and welcome to The Rambling Game Reviews of an Enthusiast! I'm a mixed Fil-Am & Ace gal who was inspired to start this blog in 2013 to drool and fangirl over fictional blushing bishies. This blog originated as a place to back up my Dialovers translations and yell about Otome games, especially through reviews.

feeds.title: Otomeology
feeds.description: Welcome to Otomeology! My name is Vira, and I run this blog. I cover anything otome-related, and primarily focus on Switch otome games. I also discuss both localized and unlocalised titles! I also love translating otome news and writing spotlight articles of upcoming games.

feeds.title: Yumemiru Sekai
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to otome games and other things related to a maiden's heart. As you can see, I mostly translate Japanese otome materials; mostly drama CDs these days, but games and novels are included. I try to keep everything on this blog related to otome games so, basically, this blog is a place to share my hobby with all of you!

feeds.title: LinLinLavender
feeds.description: My name is Lin and I love writing reviews about games I play or making videos about Otome games in general like announcements, recommendations, or even how otome games influence our psyche. What I love most about sharing my passion is that I can motivate others to stick to their Japanese learning goals and learn with you together.

feeds.title: Otome Niki
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Niki, and I like otome games! I've been playing otome games since 2012, and I like them, like, a lot. When I'm not reviewing them for sites like RPGFan, I'm playing them for fun, or playing other kinds of games like RPGs, visual novels, simulation games, and puzzle games.

feeds.title: Kvasir 369 » Otomegee
feeds.description: Check out posts on Otomegee. This is a small blog run by someone who has been a fan of anime, games, and light novels for quite some time. I use it as an outlet to give my thoughts on these different forms of media, ranging from reviews to analyses to even recommendations. To that end, while I will cover some seasonal anime, I usually have a sporadic update schedule and pretty much post on whatever topic just so happens to catch my interest.

feeds.title: Otome Otaku Girl
feeds.description: This is Dawn. I made this Blog because I LOVE playing otome/romance dating games! But like everyone, I sometimes struggle as well to get the right ending or can't get all pictures. That's why I decided to start this Blog - simply to help you all fully enjoy your games.
